text: I AM UNINSTALLING THE GAME I CANT PLAY ON 10 CREDITS A DAY. YOU MONEY GRABBERS!!! I used to love this game, but you are making it harder and harder to play. I am lucky if I get to play this once or twice a day, as I cant get credits. I only get 5 credits my friends send me, when it says there is 60 plus. its getting so frustrating now. you are very mean BB, to the players that can't afford to spend money.

I have been playing this since last 2011 and I love the game. I Love the themes and the tasks. The only problem is, I can only really play every 2 days. You don't get enough credits to play and to buy them is so expensive. I have installed and deleted this so many times as I eventually get bored of only playing one game at a time. But it is a good game and despite the lack of credits I still come back.

I used to enjoy this game when I began playing it, almost 6 years ago. It has gotten far too 'tight' and 'greedy' over time. If you do not pay to play, you have to log in for credits and save them for a week, to play ONE Epic round. Even if you do pay to play, buy credits, $24.99 gets you ONE Epic round which mostly does not gain you anything or progress you anywhere. It's all about players giving, developers receiving. I would suggest playing something else.

I have been receiving an error for a week already and tried to vontqct the technical support team but it seems that no one is willing to help me! Been playing this game everyday for 10 years. This is so heartbreaking. HELP!!!! Update: I still have the same error from a week ago. I'm sure internet is stable. Please help me. I tried everything. Uninstall/reinstall. Clear cache. EVERYTHING. Can you at least do anything from your end? Please.

BE WARNEDNEW PLAYERS!!! The games cost too many credits! The daily credits you receive don't even cover 2 games!! And I complete 1 room at a time, you cannot even attempt to complete 1 out of 6 quests as the game costs more credits than you receive. It's becoming a con now as to purchase credits is far too expensive for the little amount you get. I'm subscribed to Blitzy Plus which is £13.49pm and I'm starting to realise that's becoming a joke now to!!

They got greedy. It's a great game and gameplay is fab. But it's just super expensive, and yeah you can get bits of free credits here and there but it's next to nothing of the value of the cards to play. If you unsubscribe the monthly premium boy do you know about it. Not that you get much with that anyway! Edit after response. Yes it's free, but you barely give enough credits for a couple of games really, let's not pretend. And you can't hit the daily bonus targets if you're on the lowest tix

If you got credits you can play and it is nice game, i like to play. then when they are gone you need to pay to get more as daily gifts credits can cover one round basically. I can compare that game to today's life - everything going more and more expensive but yours wins are staying the same. I know that game for few years with biiiig pause for some time. Now I'm gonna pause it again as is no point to keep it without any credits

Pretty fun but the pay system is unbalanced. For example, I get 46 daily credits, it costs 6 per card to play the cheapest card in the regular room, and 15 credits to play the cheapest card in the special rooms. This means that I can only play ~7 regular cards a day, or 3 special cards. The credits for winning aren't good either - for example if you come in second, you just win back the same cost of a single card. It's definitely a money trap and that's a shame - it should be a bit fairer!

They've now made it harder to play for free due to not being able to spend coins on power ups. That's what coins were good for. Furious. This wasn't communicated properly. (The developer doesn't even understand their own app (given their response) enough to understand that while there is a luck element being able to use in game currency to buy power ups was a key part of helping one to progress)

This game used to be fun but since the takeover it is ridiculously hard to complete a room. When the new layout was brought in the room sizes changed it was hard enough getting 12 items now it's anything up to 16 items and the cost of reloads has gone through the roof. As a pensioner and housebound I rely on games to keep me entertained . They say it is all down to luck I say that is balderdash they are just greedy.

I used to play this game all the time a few years ago... I stopped because I got to the point where you spend more time collecting daily rewards but would take weeks And they spend more time flashing offers in you face, getting you to spend real money over and over again. Also if you are lucky to win the screen freezes every time, stopping you. And, this was after I spend money on their plus subscription... They just rip you off... I want my money back! Thief's!

Fun at first but you have to spend ridiculous amount of money to actually play. If you stay for free tournament, it's just boring as it takes months to complete. Waist of money. Edit: What I am saying is that to play one game of bingo you have to open the app few days just to collect the credits. Paying to be able to play one game is just not worth the money. Please read the comments of people playing. If you did you might have some understanding.

I have recently changed my 5* review to a 1* review unfortunately. Bingo Blitz has made it impossible to win shadow cards and therefore, you never have enough in game credits to actually play bingo. You can no longer purchase power ups and it's a real shame that the game has been changed so that it is no longer enjoyable. I lost credits in a room over a month ago and I still haven't received them, I will no longer be playing this which is a real shame after years of playing it.

This used to be a good game, but lately the higher your level the harder it gets to progress. Takes to long to get them cards you can't trade, stupid amount of credits trying, stuck on a level for over a month or two. It's boring now, also the amount of pop ups before you even get onto game is ridiculous. alot of error problems to.

This game used to be fun, but now it's gone downhill, fast. The devs constantly bring in new ways of slowing your progress by introducing new challenges that are very hard and mostly impossible to achieve without spending a bundle of real cash, and the reward is always way less than what you put in. I've lost so many friends who have jumped ship to find another bingo game, I think it's time I did the same. Dont bother with this game. Money hungry is definitely the direction this game has gone.

Used to be great now they just want your $. They have taken an excellent game and ruined it with greed. It cost $54 for 1700 credits(when they are on special offer) which just about gives you 2 rounds so they actually think 1 round of a game is worth over $25 They will tell you that you don't need to play the 900 credits per round but you don't get anywhere in the game if you don't, and no matter what they say, they don't care about players, it's all about getting as much $ from you as they can.

The game play is ok but the app is incredibly convoluted, it's not just bingo, there's a lot of side games which are very annoying. After every round of bingo there's usually 5 pop ups trying to get your money. Also, once you get past the basic levels you will find that you're saving tokens for a week just to get 2 or 3 rounds of bingo. i.e, you will get a daily allowance of 23 tokens and maybe 30 on the "spin" feature but one round of bingo at legendary level will cost you 360 tokens. uninstall

I've played this for years and now it's just getting stupid. You're stuck in one room for days, sometimes weeks! Because credit packs give nothing (not that I'd want to spend money on this these days anyway) and ungiftable shadow cards mean you can't progress. It's just gone downhill and I'm disappointed because I loved this game, but daily credits aren't even enough for one good game at my level (so yes, I also have to wait a couple of days to play one round without paying real money).

Sitting there for minutes not getting any numbers is annoying enough. The pvp actually makes the game unfun. I'd prefer it if they just let you play against ai so you aren't watching the top players run you over constantly.

the game is cool but I can't rate it 5 stars because it looks as if the main objective of the game is to take money from it's users. The rate at which uncorresponding numbers appear is so alarming. it'll force you to buy those diamond stuff so that you can continue using the game and still they'd keep giving you numbers that don't appear for you to click on. I really don't want to uninstall the game but you guys are too greedy for money. can't even pass Berlin till now

MONEY. That is all they want. I have played this for years. I'm level 553 yet my daily credits are 149. Minimum game cost 60 credits, max 900. You can't progress playing one or two games daily on minimum, most games when you level up you would get additional daily credits. Rarely get a bingo. Used to be able to get baskets hitting 5 bingos. Used to be fun. Now it's just frustrating. Stop rewarding high roll players ( golden wheel ) and help out thise without spending ridiculous amounts of money

This game is all about purchasing. You meet 4/5 purchasing adds before you actually play. It used to be fun when I originally joined in 2012. Now it is a money making cash cow. The quests are an impossibility, the game is chance if you have diamonds which you are required to purchase. Daily credits I never understand after playing so long, new players get more? The constant swapping spares to get them back to keep going. All respect has gone for the game!

The biggest problem that I have with it is that it takes too long to get more bingo tokens or finish rooms unless you're willing to pay money for them (which negates the point of the game being free). It is also impossible to complete the cooking tasks because the "rare" ingredients are hardly ever in the treasure boxes. I understand making it "challenging", but it is more frustrating than relaxing, and no one should be frustrated when playing a game meant to entertain them.

HARD TO PROGRESS! Yeah its free to play but once you progress to higher levels it won't let you give you the cards you need. You will have to play several games and I mean several before it appears and the sad part is you still won't win it. Then the cycle repeat, you will have to wait for it again. Like seriously, you kept on popping the cards already won. What am I going to do with them? And I know it is optional to pay to play but darn your credits and power ups are soooooo expensive.

I have been playing for years however the game just keeps going downhill, there is hardly anyway to gain bingo credits without having to pay and when you do have them and your in a game it freezes and you miss half the numbers been called and dont get your credits back. Another problem is I have been on the same 2 rooms for months now and still no sign of even been offered the 1s i need to complete the set. You also used to be able to buy power ups with your coins and now you can't.

Incessant unskippable cut-scenes and features. The game itself is good. But there NEEDS to be a skip option or a feature in settings to straight up scrap cutscenes. I dont want to see; pantry pass flourishes, cutscenes after a bingo, the bar loading when you complete a quest, rewards loading, the pig growing in the ranch, literally everything has a flourish and it makes me want to gouge my eyes out. Especially when I have a boost at 2 min left and I lose it because I'm stuck watching a flourish.

If the developers say it's 100% luck, they are lying. It may not be totally rigged, but there's definitely functions in place to hault your progress, in which causes you to become extremely fed up with the game as progression is near enough impossible after level 5 (Hong Kong). It is literally like all the other 'scammy' games out there, you start and progress well at the beginning and then you become trapped, and are pretty much forced to buy power-ups to make it to the next level😂 s***

Worst game I've ever played. Used to be so fun but now it's just become ridiculously impossible. •Glitches and technical problems everyday especially when in game and you lose your credits from it. •Items/Credits disappearing. •Stuck in Map rooms for months so unable to build daily credits to actually play. •Have to pay to actually get somewhere in the game but still eventually turns on you. •Unable to complete a single seasonal room as I never see any items. The list goes on..

If you want a bingo game that costs you alot of money to get anywhere then this is the one!I have played this game for years and and it used to be great but over the past few years the game has went right down hill,even at the level im on I get 125 credits a day! to play superior and have any chance of getting the items you need to complete a room or get the food items you need it costs 900 credits or more!unless you want to save for a year before playing I wouldnt bother.

Having played bingo blitz for a while now. How long does it take for an ungiftable tab to appear. I've been waiting over 2 weeks now and it's only appeared once in the time. The game use to be fun, now it's becoming more frustrating to the point I'm surprised many other players I've seen are getting frustrated with the wait on red tabs appearing and are thinking of deleting the game, as it seems the makers really want you to spend your money.

very poor game, once they're got you hooked, then they are just out for your money and don't give any big wins , left waiting weeks to win anything, just want you to buy more items all the time and no chances of winning when you do. it would be a much more fun game, if they looked after there players better. in stead of just ripping them off. Help center, just advices to play more cards, meaning buy more items to proceed in the game, useless!The game causes frustration, heart ache, after spen

The game starts off addictive and really fun to play but as you move along you start to realise the whole thing is completely rigged. Taking all your credits, making you pay before they let you win a couple of times. Some people are spending silly amounts of money. Don't play it as much now, getting stuck for weeks on levels, the game just isn't fun anymore. Total scam of a game

i really enjoy playing this game. but the time u spend accumulating credits and trying to win an item outweighs what you get in return. the silver chests always pay out aboit 6 credits, after spending 110 credits to play a game, you get one chest and many coins, you have a 6 credit return. but its constant. i have never spun the wheel and had a large number. you never get ingredients you need. i think their should be an option to trade your power ups to credits.

Have been playing since 2015! Yes It is an addictive game just gets boring when u know u can only play like 3 or 4 cards a day. I now have a list of friends who play this to help recieve the credits etc but still can't forward.....I am currently elite it's Def not worth paying every month for elite as I am still having to constantly pay for credits just to play😭 for a supposedly free fun game it's costing me way too much and the struggle and stress -it's getting not worth the hassle 😞

Editing my review from 5 stars to 1 & just uninstalled after being a long time player. This game is seriously going downhill. Only being able to play 1 game a day, if that! due to not getting enough bingo credits is not good enough if you want to keep people playing. You're acting like it's real money we are trying to win 🫠 the untradeable stickers at times take weeks to get as do the untradeable ingredients for the kitchen. STOP MAKING IT SO DIFFICULT!

Good game, but... not much free daily credit, enough for one game per day. There should be a lite version that is just the bingo and completing collections. There are too many constant pop-ups about mini games, completing games with cannon shots (even if you have no gems), and buying offers... cooking ingredients, friend trading chips and photo parts, etc. It's far too busy and convoluted in order to constantly want you to buy. There should be an option to turn off these added extra bits.

Overall the game is ok. But when you have to use thousands of credits trying to get the untradable cards and still do t get them, well that irritates me. I've been trying for 5 weeks to get untradable cards on one room and have completely run out of credits in doing so. I refuse to buy credits only to have the same problem. The game suppose to be fun and relaxing, and I just don't find that it is due to this issue.

*edit number 2 - if I could give this app zero stars I would. 4th day, still no fix. Still no credits. Still can't play. *edit - I have done as you have asked to fix it, but it still isn't loading.... 3 days now of not being able to play. It's not working on any of my devices. Missing out on all my daily credits, gifts and rewards for completing quests. Getting annoyed now.

I would give zero stars if I could. Y'all got so greedy. Since when is it more expensive to play this game then to play real bingo?! You get a measly free credit amount which is enough to play ONE game. You cant progress due to getting the same cards over an over again and you cant trade these in for credits!! Paying drew barrymore too much to appear on your game, and it shows. Deleting this game now as I've had enough. All the reviews say the same thing so clearly you listen to your players.

Used to be a really good enjoyable game. A win would give you at least enough credits for another go. Bonuses were achievable. Now it feels like the only way to succeed in this game is to spend a fortune on credits (that don't even give you enough to play the biggest boards!) & hope you get lucky. It feels like the game is more interested in paying Drew Barrymore's royalties than keeping loyal players sticking round! Plus the FB community page that refuses to allow ANY criticism is laughable!

Unplayable unless you pay a daily fee or £14.99!!!! For the premium version. This is pay to play, all in all. As a free user you can play properly maybe once a week? And even then you never win. Bored of it. Update - this game is *not* free. 3 days for credits for 2 bingo cards with 4 daubs across them. Unfortunately I have continued to play for over a year like an imbecile, however still not spent a penny. Nothing has changed. Deleted.

Used to love this game but in the last week they've taken away the ability to use coins to buy power ups so the daily tasks are now impossible which also means im not getting more credits to actually play. Recent event games are too difficult to complete. It's honestly sucking all the fun out of it. I subscribe to Bingo Plus and do buy things but thinking about quitting because they are making the game not fun anymore. What's the point in having coins if you can't use them for power ups now?

Like others since last update the app will not load and everything Playtika has claimed will fix it I have already done more than once and nothing has changed. It's clearly a fault with your app Playtika and this isn't the first time this has happened. I've lost out on the money I spent on the mini game too, it ended today so I couldn't use and lost my purchase. Doesn't even install from amazon on any of my devices. Going to start playing bingo bash

Graphics are good,the game itself has got worst. You have to spend money to progress. The higher the level more XP needed to go up which means using lots of credits. Players complain about not having enough credits/ decent power ups, chests awards. Ages in rooms as 1 to 5 the ratio is alot higher, you get plenty of spares of these. Untradeables cannot trade for another. It is not a game of luck/chance the logarithmic needs reviewing , less constant low nos & better rewards etc. FB site brill.

Its getting less and less enjoyable all the time, I'm about at the point of uninstalling it. I enjoy the game, but it would be better if when seasonal games are finishing we could trade or gift 5&6 gold level. And the lower rooms are so annoying they take forever to complete. And a lot of extra bonus games are time consuming and the graphics like double xp get in the way of the actual game.

Loved playing this game for 7 years but it's so frustrating. It uses too much data, even on home broadband it's a nightmare to load & crashes. Currently it won't load at all. The rare shadow cards hardly ever appear and when they do you can be assured that you won't receive any useful power ups. I've got over 10,000 but it is still taking me at least 4 months to complete each city room. It works out at less than 3 a year now which is a waste of time

I used to play this game every night, but can't do that now. I have to have over 110 credits to play, you have to be on "super" level. I've bought credits, still can't play every night. Very disappointed that you get the same collection items, and I am awaiting 1 that has never come up yet. Now I go in every night to get enough credit to play once or twice a week I realise you have to pay out a lot to make these games, but it's very unfair when you get to certain levels and rules change.

EDIT. I've been with bingo blitz since it was owned by Buffalo Studios, I loved the game, but 2/3 changes of ownership later, the game is terrible, many months waiting for the final items in all rooms, daily gift credits down to a quarter of what you got with Buffalo, and for the first time since installing it, after having many thousands of credits saved over the years, I had zero credits left in 3 accounts. I uninstalled all accounts. It'll be a long time b4 I go back, if ever!

Good game but you barely get any credits. Even if I wanted to buy credits I couldn't because they are so expensive. I've not had enough credits today to play one game. So just read the reply. So nothing will happen? You say that you get things for playing bingo game and then don't give them to me and your reply is that I get free credits by logging in and I can go on Facebook. I think that's a terrible attitude to have and I will be deleting the game

I am downgrading my rating to 2 stars because the amount of time it takes to complete a room is now ridiculous, the daily credits are also ridiculous, the room I am in I can play either 1 game of 4 cards or 4 games of 1 card. As for the cost of bingo credits nearly £2.00 for 30 credits, that's 1 game of 4 cards, I can play proper cash bingo for less per card. Needs to be made more player friendly.

It just ceases to be fun when you HAVE to buy credits to do anything. Once you get to a certain level, which for me was only level 46, there's simply no way to progress on. It's too much of a waste of time to play this game. Wouldn't have downloaded it if i knew only one game could be played a day but anyways moving on to see what's better out there.

Was a fun game but all they want is money! Your can't play more than 2 games a day without spending an obscene amount of cash for a measly amount of credits that will be gone in another 2 games. This app is so greedy and I'm really quite fed up of spending monthly on the plus subscription to recieve hardly anything. I think I'll just quit it and delete the app, unless it gets much better very soon. Don't give me your auto reply "we're sorry you feel that way...game is based solely on chance..."

I gave up with this game after it became impossible to play without paying. You get hardly any daily credits and either have to save them up for a month to play for a decent amount of time, or give in and buy them, especially as you hit a high level. The chests have stopped giving a decent amount of credits and the food items are damn near impossible to get to complete each section. After many years of playing, I'm done. Don't waste your time with this game.

Game has just become awful and money grabbing You can spend months on end stuck trying to get one card in one room and spent 5x the amount of credits you get to win for completion and don't even get my started on the menu features 🙄 ridiculous odds at winning the stuff you need even if you use the boost feature to win better and rarer objects and you still never see them! This game used to be so much fun now it's just stressful and not worth playing! Game uninstalled

Very disheartened. What started out as a brilliant game has now been reduced to a cash grabbing money motivated bingo game. The amount of money (real money) you have to spend to level up is extortionate. 300 credits a game if you want to level up any time soon and spending £99.99 for anywhere between 3000 & 4000 credits is ridiculous when you think about it. I am about ready to give up especially where the ungiftable items are concerned and the free items should NOT be included as bingo prizes!

I put this review on in 2018 and they replied in 2023! Wow 5 years later. That's a quick response! I don't even play anymore lol. I have been in dispute with bingo blitz regarding an unauthorised purchase and have asked for the name of the regulator to make a formal complaint but they won't supply the details or refund my purchase. Don't play because they don't care about their players!

Uninstalled after being a daily player for over 5 years. Extremely hard to progress without spending money as the daily credits you get only allow for 1 game in the higher rooms that you need to complete to keep progressing. The in-game features such as the chefs kitchen become repetitive, boring, and ridiculously hard to complete without, again, spending money.

Game is good fun but the higher you go up the map, the harder it is to earn credits. Once you run out of credits your only option is to buy them or not play at all. There definitely should be some other ways to earn credits such as playing other games or competing with others. It takes the fun out of playing when your credits run out, so I end up leaving it for months until I get a welcome back reward.

I have played this app for years and always really enjoyed it until recently. You can no longer buy power ups with coins. This makes the game so restrictive and is the worst idea the game makers could have made! I'm really not sure who thought that was a good idea. Improve the game by bringing back buying power ups with coins and stopping the game from freezing when trying to bingo.

When you have enough credits to play a round, it can be quite fun but it can take days to save enough credits to play one round. The winnings when a bingo is won are minimal and even if paying for tokens it can work out expensive just to play a round or 2. As much as its 'free' to play, it's only free if you're willing to wait days to save up credits. Just noticed its playtika and all games that have been taken over by then end up being miserable- *noted the generic response to this review*

Been playing over a year. Gradually it's gotten bad, it's definitely a pay to win game, I've spent money and had a monthly subscription. Well after today the subscription has been cancelled. It's stopped using my instant wins even though I have more than enough, takes months to get out of rooms for very little reward. And don't get me started on the American Idol game(it's horrendous)going to stick to bingo voyage from now on.

When a game requires such high credits to play higher levels then it should only be fair to be given enough credits to play at least a few rounds. I understand this is a free app and the makers need to make money somewhere but even the cheapest of credit packs have barely enough to enjoy at least 2 games. I do love the game but the higher the level, the higher the credit requirements and it is insane how long it takes to gain cards to be able to finish a room.

I have spent nearly 20 quid so far and it is literally impossible to move forwar Eventhough you have big power ups, I'm talking turbo powerup, instand win stars, they never turn up until there are nearly no bingo's left. When you do get one, less than 20'secs in the round, it will make a point of drawing numbers either side of it and let's not forget when yo so have a powerup. It's the quickest round of bingo you will see. Goes from 40 down to 3, consistently. I remind the reader, I paid.

This was an awesome game but then it got too hard to complete levels. I can only play every other day as I dont have the credits. I get 1 game of bingo every other day. Its rubbish. Then it started freezing so I was told to do lots like clear cache.nothing helped so they told me to uninstall and now it freezes on every load up. Its ridiculous. I was thinking of buying elite but I dont think I'll bother

What an appalling game. How slow would you like it to operate? Slower? Sure, why not. Whats that, you blew some dust off the screen? Okay, we'll open the shop for you mid game so you cant play for the next three minutes. Good luck! What a pathetic excuse for a development. You should all bow your heads in shame for trying to fleece unintelligent people into buying credits for this abomination of a creation.

Don't waste your time with this game, they let you win when you first sign up and then nothing. The amount of complaints about how they have fixed the game is unbelievable. Search for their bingo blitz chat on Facebook and you will see how bad the game has become. I have cancelled my plus on all 3 platforms, not getting another penny from me until they start listening to the people that pay their wages..us the players !!

Good game initially. But I had to stop playing after a month because I ran out of credits. Getting a bingo doesn't actually give you a reward, it just gives you a refund of your credits so eventually you will run out, and you only get 22 credits a day. And buying credits is extortionate. What a rip off.

The key to playing this game, is to not play it all the time. Save up credits for a year or so. Then start playing for a few weeks. Then stop again. Why, because the more you achieve the harder they make the side stuff to complete. So don't complete anything for a few months and collect only. Then again you can play for a few more weeks as the requirements for the side games are lower again. Keep taking a few months off collecting and playing for a few weeks. I currently have 371,000 credits

Not enough tokens to have a good time most days. A set algorithm. Many chats contain unhappy players because bingo blitz are really tight. As game progresses, the game gets more impossible. The daily tournament though free to take part, is a silly system. Purchased items are not price value, in fact, it's the most expensive for the tiniest amount. The golden spin cheats you.

Used to be a great game, but they've taken away the features that made it easier to play. Now everything costs cash, yet they still give out game coins (you can't buy anything with them anymore). I guess this game is at the end stage when the developers want more money from fewer players (as they jump ship).

I used to love this game. I play on my tablet which meant I had to use an arrow to access the four cards. The new layout means that by the the time I have clicked the arrow and flicked the cards I have a late bingo or missed numbers. Reduced number of cards I play and get no numbers!. Lots of prompts to spend money on power ups etc far too many "side games" I am now deleting app. Good luck to all.🙂

I have been playing this game since 2011, and since the new owners took over, I'm afraid to say it's an absolute nightmare to get anything, it's a free game to play, but you can purchase items with real money, I am very disappointed as now they have made it that you cannot move on, as they are trying to get you to buy, so therefore have made it impossible and very frustrating to say the least 😒 so basically you are not moving forward so often as you would due to the new owners and GREED! SAD!

Loved the game. Was 5+ stars. till they took away the option to use blitz coins (in game money not real money) to purchase power ups. Over 90% of quests are power up based( like use 4 instant wins). This makes completing them virtually impossible. Most players rely on quests to get the ungiftable items. Bring that option back or an option to buy specific power ups. Not random. I used to spend real money on credits but now I refuse to spend a penny. Will uninstall if not changed back.

This game has become very dull and boring. There is no choice which rooms to play u now have to complete 1 before moving on to next. Bingo's are far less frequent, and the rewards much MUCH LOWER than before. It's designed to drain your credits fast. Creators need to return the game to the prior format. Another site could simply adopt what bingo blitz has dropped and players will switch in an instant. The end is in sight for bingo blitz.

What the hell. Downloaded. Got 1 game out of it. Then purchased second game just for it to unable to connect so couldn't play closed window went back in 4 times. Same issue every time. What a waste of time. If I could give less than 1 star u would of. Don't waste your time with game you could get more entertainment counting grains of sugar.

The newbie rooms are perfectly fine with an even balance but after clearing those the play cost gets so high you can't play more than a single game a day... Max daily credits 126 roughly yet 120 credit cost for a single game in the new room! Company obviously used to gambling apps and doesn't know how to effectively run and manage a free to play game. I would recommend increasing the daily credit amount and the amount of credits obtained for those who purchase or reducing the cost per game.

Great game.
